landingHeroSubtitle: Monitor, control, and diagnose the health of your entire distributed infrastructure in real-time from a high-performance centralized console.
landingAboutDescription: Orchestrack is a centralized SaaS platform focused on observability, real-time monitoring, and management of clusters and connected remote servers.
landingObjectiveDescription: Eliminate operational blindness and fragmentation in distributed environments by unifying continuous telemetry (metrics, logs, events), intelligent root cause diagnosis, and direct management of any type of container into a single console.
landingSdlcStep1Desc: Resource and log validation in pre-production environments.
landingSdlcStep3Desc: Live monitoring and root cause detection for incidents.
landingSdlcStep4Desc: Forensic evidence snapshots for local bug fixing.
landingSdlcStep1Back: Allows developers to inspect the behavior of their containers, logs, and resource consumption in multi-cluster test environments without relying on tickets or manual SSH permissions.
landingSdlcStep2Back: Provides immediate visibility after a new deployment. If a new version causes a memory spike or network failures, the system detects it in less than 10 seconds before massive affectation.
landingSdlcStep3Back: Automates event correlation. When an incident occurs, it automatically answers the 5 critical questions: What happened? Where did it start? How did it propagate? What transaction did it affect? And what evidence backs it up?
landingSdlcStep4Back: By capturing frozen snapshots of forensic evidence (raw logs, metric dumps at the exact second of the crash), engineers can reproduce the failure in their local environment with irrefutable proof, closing the loop between operations and development.
landingCtaHook: Orchestrack is the centralized SaaS platform that connects your clusters, analyzes the root cause of incidents, and gives you total control over your containers and infrastructure in real time.
landingDiffHook: In modern architectures composed of microservices and multiple clusters, monitoring isolated metrics is no longer enough. Orchestrack connects all your remote servers into a single control plane, transforming scattered data into clear explanations about the health, capacity, and behavior of your infrastructure.
landingPillar1Desc: Continuous CPU, Memory, Disk, and Network metrics transmitted every 10 seconds via WebSockets.
landingPillar2Desc: Automatic root cause diagnosis, cascading propagation map, and forensic evidence.
landingPillar3Desc: Centralized control of containers (Docker, Podman, containerd, CRI) and OS package administration without SSH access.
landingSignupHeader: Connect and monitor your clusters in less than 5 minutes.
landingSignupGuarantee: No credit card required. Single-line installation.
landingFeature1Desc: Monitor CPU, Memory, Disk, and network traffic on each server. Start, stop, restart, or remove any type of container, inspect live logs, and manage images across multiple clusters on a single screen.
landingFeature2Desc: When a failure occurs, Orchestrack analyzes the timeline of events to automatically identify the exact origin of the incident (Root Cause), avoiding alert fatigue from secondary alarms.
landingFeature3Desc: Visualize how a node failure transmits across your clusters' dependency map and calculate the blast radius across your entire infrastructure.
landingFeature4Desc: Link infrastructure outages to specific requests and services that were interrupted on connected servers, allowing you to understand the real impact on users.
landingFeature5Desc: Automatically capture a frozen snapshot of raw logs, kernel events, and resource consumption at the exact second of the failure. Generate an exportable ZIP/JSON audit package for post-mortem analysis.
landingSolution1Title: Elimination of Blind Spots in Hybrid Clusters
landingSolution1Desc: Unify servers in the public cloud, private infrastructure, or edge environments in a centralized console without tool fragmentation.
landingSolution2Desc: Connect development and operations teams. By immediately presenting the root cause and evidence, reduce incident resolution time from hours to minutes.
landingSolution3Desc: Manage OS packages and inspect containers through a secure agent (orchestrack-agent) with a dedicated user and minimum permissions, eliminating the risks of shared SSH access.
landingPricingPhilosophy: Clear billing model based on connected servers/clusters, eliminating unpredictable charges for log volume or ingested metrics.
landingAboutMissionDesc: Facilitate the observability and management of complex infrastructures, giving engineering teams absolute clarity and real-time control over their clusters.
landingAboutArch3Desc: Event correlation engine and central API.
